name: nz-ea-wholesale-price-exceedance
description: For a New Zealand electricity island, at the publication instant of the final wholesale energy prices for trading day D (conservatively D + 6 calendar days, covering the maximum publication lag measured on the publisher's daily-file channel), given the published island daily mean final prices for trading days up to and including D, will the island daily mean final price on trading day D+7 exceed NZD 100/MWh?
source: Electricity Authority (Te Mana Hiko) EMI 'Final energy prices' (Real-time dispatch and pricing), Azure blob container
license: Source: CC BY 4.0 (attribution 'www.emi.ea.govt.nz provided by the Electricity Authority (New Zealand)'; EMI LegalInformation and the successor hub copyright statement). Our derived compilation is dedicated CC0-1.0. Derived research dataset - not the Authority's official product.

split.strategy: temporal on the anchor trading day; the eval->holdout boundary is the documented 2022-11-01 real-time pricing regime change

label_rule: island daily mean of DollarsPerMegawattHour over trading day D+7 exceeds NZD 100/MWh (threshold frozen from the training-window design)
prediction_time: the publication instant of final prices for trading day D. The Authority documents that interim prices 'will be declared to be final prices by 2pm the following business day'; measured on the daily-file channel, Last-Modified minus trade date is 0-5 calendar days over 365+ files, so the instant is placed at D + 6 calendar days. Features are final prices for trading days <= D; the target trading day D+7 has not finished trading at the instant, so its price cannot exist there.
